parsed.summary: The PR introduces a non-minimal change and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change introduces a call to _set_parameters(best_params) which is not directly related to the issue of fit_predict and predict disagreeing when n_init > 1. This suggests scope creep.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that fit_predict and predict now agree when n_init > 1. The existing test_gaussian_mixture_fit_predict does not cover this case.
